intro.text: A nation that keeps a standing army ready for the Wyrn's use.
A rural, isolated nation in the southeast of the Fjordell Empire, whose standing army is ready for the Wyrn's use.

description.text: Its people hear little of events in the wider world, and their dialect has drifted so far that many Fjordell struggle to follow it.
The Hroven Forton is skilled at brewing elixirs.
Shu-Dereth is the state religion, but some remote places go months without a visit from a Derethi priest, and other faiths, among them the Jeskeri Mysteries, are still followed in secret.
